scope: Testlab Playwright scenario definitions and current implementation references. Retired local backend tests are historical evidence only, excluded from current coverage and CI.

legend.P0: Release-critical money, identity, ownership, or core behavior
legend.B: Playwright browser plus authoritative API assertions
legend.I: Integration through deployed testlab APIs and workers; fault cases require restricted testlab controls where indicated
legend.S: Real Stripe test-mode contract plus app ledger where applicable

groups.name: Checkout identity and profile sequence
groups.existingCoverage: Existing PostCheckoutAccountServiceTests, AuthServiceTests, AuthControllerPostCheckoutAccountTests, postCheckoutAccountFlow.test.ts and account proxy tests; browser sequence and real cookie identity remain to implement.

groups.name: Kickback eligibility, personal codes, and auth continuation
groups.existingCoverage: BuyerPromotionServiceTests and buyerPromotion helper tests cover branches; real repository races and full modal/auth sequence are missing.

groups.name: Organizer controls and lifecycle
groups.existingCoverage: EventsServiceTests, BuyerPromotionSettingsTests, BuyerPromotionServiceTests, organizer controller tests; no dedicated Playwright coverage.

groups.name: Shared onboarding countries and Stripe account lifecycle
groups.existingCoverage: StripeOnboardingCountryPolicyTests, repository tests, EventPromotersOnboardingTests, organizer onboarding tests and selector/navigation tests; real UI/provider journey remains.

groups.name: Attribution and commission arithmetic
groups.existingCoverage: PaymentsServiceTests, PromoterSettlementServiceTests, CommissionProcessingServiceTests and ledger tests cover many calculations; endpoint-to-ledger assertions and real funding are missing.

groups.name: Wallet requests and payout execution
groups.existingCoverage: PromoterWalletServiceTests and frontend wallet tests exist; real Mongo claims, worker execution, and browser balances remain to implement.

groups.name: Mixed settlement, currencies, and geography
groups.existingCoverage: Cross-event currency unit tests and the older organizer/currency matrix exist; the single-promoter mixed wallet/automatic lifecycle is not covered.

groups.name: Refunds, processing failures, and recovery
groups.existingCoverage: RefundsServiceTests, PromoterPaymentsServiceFullTests and processor/admin tests cover individual branches; ordered failure/recovery journeys need integration tests.

groups.name: Portal, permissions, reporting, and UX
groups.existingCoverage: PromoterPaymentsServiceFullTests, portal helper/component tests and controller tests exist; complete browser/API authorization and pagination require coverage.

groups.name: Notifications and asynchronous operational evidence
groups.existingCoverage: PromoterNotificationServiceTests, BuyerPromotionEmailOfferBuilderTests and admin tests exist; captured-mail end-to-end assertions remain.
